nodes.name: PDF Combine
nodes.description: Local-first Flask web app for joining PDFs: folder-path scanning (Windows only), file uploads, images-to-PDF with a four-point crop/adjust editor, and mixed PDF+image combining. Deployable to Render; all temp files live in the OS temp dir and expire after 1 hour.

nodes.name: Flask backend
nodes.description: Single-file Flask server exposing the index page, four JSON API routes, security headers, a 413 handler, and temp-file cleanup before each request. Serves static frontend; stateless apart from temp dirs and FOLDER_OUTPUTS.

nodes.name: Frontend controller
nodes.description: Vanilla-JS single-page controller for four source tabs (folder, upload, mixed, images). Manages shared `state`, file queues with drag-reorder, the canvas crop editor, and all fetch calls to the API.

nodes.name: Index template
nodes.description: Jinja2 template rendering the app shell: header, source tabs (folder tab omitted unless folder_enabled), four source panels, combine queue, image editor markup, and status line.

nodes.name: Stylesheet
nodes.description: Styling for the shell, tabs, drop zones, queues, image editor, and status messages.

nodes.name: Flask config
nodes.description: MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH = 500 MB per request; ALLOW_FOLDER_PATHS from env ALLOW_FOLDER_PATHS (default true) gates folder-path features. Dev server on 127.0.0.1:5000.

nodes.name: Render deployment
nodes.description: Render Web Service blueprint: uv sync --frozen then Gunicorn. Folder-path features disabled in deployment (server cannot access visitor files).

nodes.name: cleanup_expired_files
nodes.description: Deletes files in UPLOAD_DIR/OUTPUT_DIR older than TEMP_FILE_TTL_SECONDS (1 hour).

nodes.name: is_pdf
nodes.description: True if path is an existing file with .pdf suffix (case-insensitive).

nodes.name: list_pdfs
nodes.description: Lists PDFs directly inside a folder (alphabetical), returning path/name/size; raises ValueError if folder missing.

nodes.name: merge_pdfs
nodes.description: Merges PDF files in order into an output file with PdfWriter; raises if no pages added; always closes writer.

nodes.name: add_image_page
nodes.description: Converts one uploaded image (EXIF-transposed, alpha pasted on white) into a 150-DPI PDF page appended to a writer.

nodes.name: merge_mixed_files
nodes.description: Joins uploaded PDFs and images in received order; raises ValueError for unsupported types or empty result.

nodes.name: normalized_points
nodes.description: Validates four normalized crop points (TL,TR,BR,BL), clamped to [0,1]; falls back to full-image corners on invalid input.

nodes.name: crop_and_adjust
nodes.description: Quad-transforms an image to the crop polygon, applies brightness/contrast/saturation/grayscale/sepia, returns composited RGB page.

nodes.name: images_to_pdf
nodes.description: Writes uploaded images as a single multi-page PDF applying per-image crop/adjust edits; raises if no images.

nodes.name: available_output_path
nodes.description: Picks combined.pdf or combined-N.pdf in a directory without overwriting existing files.

nodes.name: GET /
nodes.description: Renders index.html, passing folder_enabled to control folder tab visibility.

nodes.name: POST /api/folder-pdfs
nodes.description: Lists PDFs in a posted folder path; 403 if folder paths disabled, 400 on bad folder. Wraps list_pdfs.

nodes.name: POST /api/upload
nodes.description: Saves uploaded PDFs to UPLOAD_DIR under uuid tokens; returns id/name/size; 400 if none accepted.

nodes.name: POST /api/combine
nodes.description: Merges selected PDFs from folder (saved next to source, no overwrite) or uploads (output to OUTPUT_DIR, uploads deleted). Returns /api/download/<id>; 400 on errors.

nodes.name: POST /api/images-to-pdf
nodes.description: Builds a PDF from up to 40 uploaded images plus JSON edits (crop points, brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, sepia).

nodes.name: POST /api/mixed-to-pdf
nodes.description: Combines up to 40 uploaded PDFs and images in order into one PDF; deletes output on failure.

nodes.name: GET /api/download/<output_id>
nodes.description: Sends combined-<id>.pdf or images-<id>.pdf or a tracked folder output; validates id is alphanumeric; deletes OUTPUT_DIR file after download; 404 if gone.

nodes.name: clean_temporary_files (before_request)
nodes.description: Runs cleanup_expired_files before every request.

nodes.name: add_security_headers (after_request)
nodes.description: Adds nosniff, DENY framing, and same-origin referrer headers.

nodes.name: too_large (413 handler)
nodes.description: Returns JSON error for uploads over the 500 MB limit.

nodes.name: state / helpers ($, status, bytes)
nodes.description: Global UI state (source, files, images, mixedFiles, drag indices) plus status-message helper with 5s auto-clear and byte formatting.

nodes.name: render
nodes.description: Renders the PDF file queue: selection checkboxes, ordering, drag-and-drop, up/down buttons, select-all state.

nodes.name: setSource
nodes.description: Switches active tab, clears file list, toggles the four source panels, re-renders.

nodes.name: upload
nodes.description: POSTs selected PDF files to /api/upload as multipart form and appends returned items to state.files.

nodes.name: Image editor (addImages, renderCropCanvas, renderImage, updateImage, pointer handlers)
nodes.description: Canvas-based four-corner crop editor: object-URL bitmaps, draggable handles, live CSS filters, brightness/contrast/saturation sliders, B&W/sepia/reset/remove actions.

nodes.name: images-to-pdf submit
nodes.description: Sends images + JSON edits array to /api/images-to-pdf and triggers download of the result.

nodes.name: Mixed queue (renderMixed, addMixed, moveMixed)
nodes.description: Manages the mixed PDF/image list with drag-reorder, removal, and submission to /api/mixed-to-pdf.

nodes.name: Source tabs
nodes.description: Buttons with data-source (folder/upload/mixed/images); folder tab hidden when folder_enabled is false.

nodes.name: Drop zones
nodes.description: file-input (PDFs), image-input (images), mixed-input (PDFs+images) with dragover highlight.

nodes.name: Queue sections
nodes.description: file-list (PDF combine order) and mixed-list (mixed order) with select-all, clear, and combine buttons.

nodes.name: Image editor markup
nodes.description: Canvas preview, nav prev/next, adjustment sliders (brightness/contrast/saturation), filter buttons, and Save as PDF action.

nodes.name: Status line
nodes.description: aria-live status paragraph updated by the status() helper.
